Column section temperatures rising in ordered profile (top coolest), normal heat-up gradient
System pressure steady ~698 mbar, column dP ~1 mbar, no flooding or blockage
Reflux flow at 0.0 and FT703 drifting down, consistent with pre-reflux heat-up phase
